turns.question: How many customers did we have in September 2026?
turns.answer: "Customers" can mean three things, so for September 2026 (1 to 30 September): signups 9 (customers who signed up that month), active customers 10 (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order that month), and customers to date 30 (everyone signed up by 30 September). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
